Select molecule identifiers as compound_chembl_id, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, activity type, relation, value, units, comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Filter for standard_type IC50, standard_units nM, and target CHEMBL4282. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
